resources.string: Off by default. Only the tracks you listen to are sent.
Authorize Songlass on Last.fm, then come back and complete the connection.
Removes the session key and the listens waiting to be sent. The API key stays.
Create credentials at last.fm/api. The key and secret stay on this device and are excluded from backups.
Enter an API key and secret to connect Last.fm.
Last.fm is unreachable. The listens stay queued and are retried later.
Last.fm asked to slow down. The listens stay queued.
Last.fm has a temporary problem. The listens stay queued.
The session is no longer valid. Connect again to send the queued listens.
Last.fm rejected the API key. Check the key and secret.
Last.fm returned an unusable response. The listens stay queued and are retried later.
Sends only the artist, title, album, duration and time of each listen.
The session key is kept in this app’s private preferences, protected by the operating system but not encrypted by Songlass.
Removes the session, the pending listens and the API key from this device, and turns scrobbling off.
Scrobbling is not available on this platform yet.
